constraints: This command must generally be called within an error-handling method installed via ON ERR CALL.
errODBC and errSQLServer are only filled when the error originates from the ODBC source; otherwise they are returned empty.

overloadMerges.note: autoparse defaulted all four params to direction:"in" from the blanket rule; the doc parameter table marks errCode, errText, errODBC and errSQLServer all as "<-" (out) -- there are no input params for this command.
